Leadership became more concrete when I had to practise it in different systems: a football midfield, a school team, and the student council.
:::

## School Prefect

In 2026, I was selected as School Prefect at Sri Kumaran Children’s Home. The role adds a formal responsibility to habits I had already been learning through sport: notice what others cannot see, communicate early, and represent a group rather than only myself.

![](/assets/record/school-prefect-parents.jpg){.project-screenshot fig-alt="Satvik Raman with his parents after being appointed School Prefect"}
